evidence: Nestled within the bustling neighborhood adjacent to Thong Nhat Park in Hanoi, Lake Ba Mau stands out as a serene oasis, its tranquil waters reflecting the sky above and offering a respite from the city’s frenetic pace. The lake’s name, "Ba Mau," translates to "Three Mau," a reference to the traditional Vietnamese unit of land measurement, suggesting that the area once encompassed approximately three such units.
